response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with a strong web/full-stack and testing background, but the profile does not align with this role's hard requirements. Native-level Japanese is mandatory and there is no evidence of any Japanese proficiency (English, Romanian, basic German only). C for UNIX development appears only in a ~6-month stint at National Instruments over a decade ago, and there is no demonstrated Linux kernel analysis/modification, embedded LAN-switch firmware, or network security experience (MACsec, 802.1X, Captive Portal, L2/L3, switch SDKs). The overlap is largely limited to general Linux familiarity and broad engineering maturity, which is not sufficient for a mid-senior specialist embedded security position.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software engineering experience across many domains
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, tooling, open-source ownership
Some low-level exposure (C/C++ at National Instruments, C++/Linux audio thesis)
concerns: No Japanese language ability — a mandatory requirement
No embedded networking, switch firmware, or security-protocol experience
Minimal and dated C/UNIX work; no Linux kernel source modification

key_factors.factor: Lack of embedded/network security domain experience
Weak, dated C and kernel-level proficiency
